messages:
ava: Heads up — console team enabled the new emit-route-metadata toggle for 10% canary in prod this morning. seeing spike of 500 errors from some customers. not widespread but noisy. @maria can you take a look?

sam: linked the chart: https://console.redwood.dev/d/route-errors?panelId=3 — errors correlate with the canary window starting at 09:12 UTC. traces show client-side panics during response parsing.

maria: looking. any examples of failing clients/orgs?

ava: reported by acme-inc and small-infra. logs: "panic: invalid character '}' looking for beginning of object key string" while parsing X-Redwood-Route header.

maria: ahhh — the console started embedding a JSON blob in X-Redwood-Route for richer routing telemetry. we recently added a helper in Go SDK that auto-parses that header into RouteMetadata struct, but we assumed it's always valid JSON. old clients expect either absent header or a simple string token.

oliver: tl;dr: header payload shape changed + Go SDK did an unchecked json.Unmarshal => panic.

maria: creating hotfix PR now that guards: if header present, try json.Unmarshal and fall back to raw string on error. will add tests for malformed payloads. (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/pull/789)

hannah: product: we prefer a hotfix + a rollback of the toggle for the canary cohort until fix ships. we can't risk broader customer disruption. :+1:

sam: agree. can we roll the canary back to 0% while we validate?

deploy-bot: Rollback request received for feature flag emit-route-metadata. Initiating rollback for canary cohort (10% -> 0%). ETA ~6m.

oliver: monitoring: error rate trending down as rollback progresses. keeping eyes on repros.

maria: CI green, added defensive parsing and added a compatibility test (header present but non-json -> should not panic). will cut v0.9.3 patch once approvals done.

ava: thanks. two follow-ups: 1) console team — can we change flag behavior to send header only when client advertises support (via Accept-Route-Meta header)? 2) devex: need a short advisory for SDK consumers about tolerant parsing in next patch.

sam: console: we can implement a negotiation header. pref: server sends X-Redwood-Route only if client sends Accept-Route-Meta=1 or if SDK handshake indicates support. will add a ticket.

maria: drafting release notes now. will include migration guidance: Go/TS/py clients should treat route header as optional and be resilient to non-json payloads.

hannah: product approves rollback and the negotiation change. once patch released, we can re-enable canary at 5% then 20%. keep me posted.

oliver: follow-up ops task: add an alert on "sdk-client-panic:unhandled" so we catch parsing panics earlier.

maria: v0.9.3 released (tag v0.9.3) and published to our registry. linking changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/releases/tag/v0.9.3

ava: re-enabling canary to 5% now with negotiation header off by default. will re-run ramp once telemetry shows stable. thanks everyone for quick turn. :rocket:
